skill.name: mixpanel-automation
skill.description: Automate Mixpanel analytics workflows through Rube MCP, including events, segmentation, funnels, cohorts, profiles, and JQL queries.
skill.summary: Guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Mixpanel analytics workflows using Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown tool names, parameters, and examples. I confirmed one low network dependency because the skill directs users to connect a remote Rube MCP endpoint. Semantic findings note third-party Mixpanel data access and optional profile write operations.

remediation.suggestion: Document what Rube MCP can access and require user confirmation before connecting the remote MCP server.

remediation.issue: Third-party access to Mixpanel analytics data
remediation.suggestion: Add least-privilege guidance and tell users to verify the Mixpanel account scope before authentication.

remediation.issue: Batch profile updates can modify analytics records
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit dry run, exact change summary, and user approval before profile batch updates run.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Mixpanel connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `mixpanel`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `MIXPANEL_GET_ALL_PROJECTS` - List projects to get project ID [Prerequisite]
- `event`: Event name or array of event names to aggregate
- `limit`: Maximum number of segments to return
- The `on` parameter uses Mixpanel property expression syntax
- Segmentation on high-cardinality properties returns capped results; use `limit`
1. `MIXPANEL_LIST_FUNNELS` - List saved funnels to find funnel ID [Prerequisite]
- `funnel_id`: ID of the saved funnel to query
- `funnel_id` is required; resolve via LIST_FUNNELS first
- Conversion window (`length`) defaults vary; set explicitly for accuracy
- `output_properties`: Array of property names to include in results
- `session_id`: Session ID for consistent pagination (from first response)
- For batch update: array of profile updates with `$distinct_id` and property operations
- Profile queries return paginated results; use `session_id` from first response for consistent pagi
- `where` uses Mixpanel expression syntax for profile properties
- Cohorts can be used as filters in other queries via `where` expressions
1. `MIXPANEL_JQL_QUERY` - Execute a custom JQL (JavaScript Query Language) query [Optional]
- For JQL: `script` containing the JQL JavaScript code
- For Insight: `bookmark_id` of the saved insight
- Insight `bookmark_id` must reference an existing saved insight
- Profile queries: Use `page` number and `session_id` for consistent results
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Cohorts are created and managed in Mixpanel UI; API provides read access

content.user_title: Automate Mixpanel Analytics with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Mixpanel analysis often requires repeated project, event, funnel, cohort, and profile queries. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for reliable Mixpanel automation.
actual_capabilities: Lists Mixpanel projects and resolves project identifiers before analysis.
Aggregates event counts across date ranges and time units.
Runs segmentation and funnel workflows with property filters.
Queries user profiles and describes safe batch update patterns.
Lists saved cohorts and explains cohort identifiers.
Runs JQL and saved insight workflows when the connected toolkit supports them.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Mixpanel connection before any workflow can run.
Depends on current Rube tool schemas, so the model must search tools first.
Does not create Mixpanel funnels or cohorts that must be defined in the Mixpanel UI.
Large queries may hit Mixpanel rate limits, time limits, or plan limits.

use_cases.title: Track Product Event Trends
use_cases.description: Aggregate signups, activations, purchases, or custom events by day, week, or month.

use_cases.title: Investigate Funnel Drop-Off
use_cases.description: Resolve a saved funnel and query conversion rates across dates and key segments.

use_cases.title: Audit User Segments
use_cases.description: Query profiles and cohorts to compare plans, regions, lifecycle stages, or campaign groups.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Mixpanel Rube MCP tools to list my accessible projects. Search for the current tool schema first, then show each project name and identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Aggregate an Event
prompt_templates.prompt: Get daily unique counts for the event I specify between two dates. Confirm the project, event name, date range, and time unit before running the Mixpanel query.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Funnel Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the saved funnel by name, query it for the last 30 days, and segment the result by the property I provide. Summarize conversion and drop-off patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Profile Cohort Investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: List relevant cohorts, query matching profiles with selected output properties, and recommend a safe profile update plan. Do not run batch updates until I approve the exact changes.

output_examples.input: Show weekly unique signup events for the production project last month.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the production project, confirms the date range, and reports weekly unique signup totals with a short trend summary.

output_examples.input: Analyze checkout funnel conversion by country for the last 14 days.
output_examples.output: The response resolves the saved funnel, runs the segmented query, and highlights the countries with the largest conversion changes.

output_examples.input: Find premium users missing an onboarding property and prepare an update.
output_examples.output: The response queries matching profiles, lists the affected count, and prepares a reviewable update plan without applying changes.

best_practices: Search Rube MCP tool schemas before every workflow because schemas can change.
Confirm project, date range, event names, and filters before running large queries.
Require explicit approval before any profile batch update or destructive change.
anti_patterns: Do not assume event names, property names, or funnel identifiers from memory.
Do not run broad profile queries without output property limits and pagination planning.
Do not execute JQL or batch updates until the user reviews the scope.

faq.question: Does this skill require Mixpanel API keys?
faq.answer: It uses Rube MCP connection management. Users authenticate Mixpanel through the connected Rube workflow.

faq.question: Can it create new funnels or cohorts?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on querying existing funnels and listing existing cohorts from Mixpanel.

faq.question: Can it update user profiles?
faq.answer: Yes, it describes profile batch update workflows. Users should approve exact changes before any update runs.

faq.question: Why must the model search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change. Searching first helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use current parameters.

faq.question: Does it support custom JQL?
faq.answer: Yes, when the connected Mixpanel toolkit exposes JQL. JQL availability can vary because Mixpanel treats it as a legacy feature.

faq.question: What data can be accessed?
faq.answer: Access depends on the authenticated Mixpanel account and Rube connection scope. Project, event, funnel, cohort, and profile data may be available.
